Explore the references associated with the AHEAD indicators. Use the search box and column filters to find publications, guidelines and other resources.

```{r}
invisible(
  suppressWarnings(
    suppressMessages({
      library(data.table)
      library(rjson)
      library(reactable)
      library(htmltools)
    })
  )
)

references_dir <- "../references/"

fls <- list.files(
  references_dir,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.json$",
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

# Exclude template file
template_files <- c(
  "0_reference_template.json"
)

fls <- fls[
  !tolower(basename(fls)) %in% tolower(template_files)
]

if (length(fls) == 0L) {
  stop("No reference JSON files found after excluding templates.")
}

# Columns displayed in the References table
reference_fields <- c(
  "Resource",
  "Agency",
  "Year",
  "Responsible",
  "Description",
  "Type",
  "Link",
  "Dimension",
  "Indicator",
  "Code Available",
  "Tool Available"
)

# Convert each field into one table cell.
# Arrays such as Dimension and Indicator become comma-separated text.
as_cell <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value) || length(value) == 0L) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  values <- unlist(value, use.names = FALSE)

  if (length(values) == 0L || all(is.na(values))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(as.character(values[!is.na(values)]), collapse = ", ")
}

references_dt <- lapply(fls, function(file) {

  json_data <- fromJSON(
    paste(readLines(file, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  )

  # Support both the new nested format and existing flat records.
  if (!is.null(json_data$Observatory)) {
    reference_data <- json_data$Observatory
  } else {
    reference_data <- json_data
  }

  row <- lapply(reference_fields, function(field) {
    as_cell(reference_data[[field]])
  })

  names(row) <- reference_fields

  as.data.table(row)
})


references_dt <- rbindlist(
  references_dt,
  idcol = "id",
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

reactable(
  references_dt,

  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  striped = FALSE,

  fullWidth = TRUE,
  compact = FALSE,

  defaultPageSize = 15,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50),
  paginationType = "jump",

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    resizable = TRUE,
    minWidth = 150,

    headerStyle = list(
      background = "#f4f2ff",
      color = "#30256f",
      fontWeight = "700",
      borderBottom = "3px solid #5544cc",
      padding = "12px"
    ),

    style = list(
      padding = "12px",
      whiteSpace = "normal",
      lineHeight = "1.45",
      verticalAlign = "top"
    )
  ),

  columns = list(

    id = colDef(
      name = "ID",
      width = 70,
      minWidth = 70,
      align = "center",
      sticky = "left",

      headerStyle = list(
        background = "#5544cc",
        color = "white",
        fontWeight = "700",
        borderBottom = "3px solid #5544cc"
      ),

      style = list(
        background = "white",
        color = "#5544cc",
        fontWeight = "700"
      )
    ),

    Indicator = colDef(
      name = "Indicators",
      minWidth = 220,

      style = list(
        color = "#5544cc",
        fontSize = "0.84rem"
      )
    ),

    Link = colDef(
      name = "Link",
      minWidth = 120,

      cell = function(value) {

        if (
          is.null(value) ||
          length(value) == 0 ||
          is.na(value) ||
          value == ""
        ) {
          return("")
        }

        tags$a(
          href = value,
          target = "_blank",
          rel = "noopener noreferrer",
          "View reference"
        )
      }
    )
  ),

  theme = reactableTheme(
    borderColor = "#dedbea",
    highlightColor = "#f4f2ff",
    cellPadding = "10px 12px",

    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Comfortaa, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "0.86rem"
    ),

    searchInputStyle = list(
      width = "280px",
      border = "1px solid #c9c3e5",
      borderRadius = "8px",
      padding = "9px 12px"
    ),

    selectStyle = list(
      border = "1px solid #c9c3e5",
      borderRadius = "8px",
      padding = "6px"
    ),

    paginationStyle = list(
      marginTop = "18px"
    )
  )
)
```
